description: S468 fix round 1: a render-time call to a server function in a markup `${ … }` interpolation OUTSIDE any `<errorBoundary>` is a server call in a value position and is E-VALUE-SERVER-CALL (§13.7). S470: impl#1 now refuses a waiting value in every render position (ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S469 item 1), so this case passes on impl#1 (its xfail removed); the carried g-impl1-value-server-call-s451 is pinned by server-fn/value-server-call-init-neg (a cell initializer).
rationale: §13.7 rule item 1 + normative statement: a call whose callee is server-placed SHALL NOT appear in a value position. Server data reaches markup through a `<request>` (§6.7.7).
